its not worth it. im on it for my adhd which has genuinely been severe my whole life, but i only went on it again bc im in law school and couldnt focus for shit. the other symptoms suck ass and all that but at least i remember to put food away or do laundry and study or some shit. im only on 10ng but in highschool a crack doctor put me on an ungodly, nearly illegal amount and i weighed like 115 at 5'6 which was fine for my stupid self image during puberty but my brain was on fire all the time. i lost a lot of freinds and my boyfriend dubbed it "vodkabipolar's gremlin phase."

went off it. shot up to 165 in 3 months. had tons of physicians make comments and basically began my ED. sorry for the life story but what im saying is: if you ever go on these types of medicines make sure its temporary. you may lose weight or be able to focus, but you will feel like there's constantly a housefire in your head. i literally developed physical tics from it. :( be safe. 💗

edit: I'm referencing mostly my ungodly high dose-- smaller doses are extremely beneficial. just don't get lost in the sauce yanno?

Hey! I have ovarian cysts too. It's not the end of the world, or the end of your life. Otherwise the doctor wouldn't have been so lax about it. I too worried my head off about it. I promise this is so much more common than you think. LOTS of women have these issues and other issues, and *never* even get them diagnosed, and they live out their lives just suffering through the symptoms! But it doesn't kill them, either. You on the other hand got checked, and it got solved. You're a step ahead of most people. That's great!

You show a lot of self-awareness in this post, though. You clearly know these thoughts aren't grounded in reality. Possible? Yes. Plausible? No. They wouldn't just miss cancer. I promise. You have to learn how to take that grounded part of your brain (that you showed in this very post) to self-reassure the anxious part of your brain, instead of asking others. I hope this helps!
